card.name: Sample and subgroup statistics wording
card.fires_on: Words in statistics and census-style text that name a sample or subgroup, such as 'sample' before means, or males and females in median income lines. Also fires on odd spots inside citations.

card.writes: It lowers words like population and entire, so the model is less likely to say the whole population and more likely to stay on samples or subgroups.
card.plain: It marks text about a sample or a subgroup in statistics, steering away from words about the whole population.
